Chapter 6718: Final Winner

Chapter 6718: Final Winner

“Boom!” In her strongest state, she pushed the tribulation up above the firmament.

This made people think about cultivators capable of severing the tribulations. The lord took it in another direction, pushing the tribulation back to its source. Not even Zhan Sansheng or Desolate Ancestor went this far.

Although the ocean of lightning was forced to return, one remnant bolt pierced her defense and body, causing her to fall from the sky.

Li Qiye made his move and caught her, healing her grievous injury with his will in the blink of an eye.

“Your Majesty.” Joy gleamed in her eyes upon seeing him but she was exhausted.

“You did it, rest now.” Li Qiye closed her eyes, allowing her to sleep in his embrace.

He then carried her to Life and Death Heaven.

“Your Majesty.” Everyone there including Guardian Blade and Immortal Slayer Guard knelt on the ground.

Once they did, spectators in Three Immortals also knelt to show respect. Li Qiye’s actual identity didn’t matter. He was obviously the master of their world and all others.

He had defeated everyone and proved his supremacy. It appeared only the high heaven could match him.

Others could only look up at him. The great geniuses were left speechless. After all, even an overlord was insignificant in comparison. This also applied to immortals and the various stages.

Even great immortals such as Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation couldn’t reach the shore. However, the so-called “let go” stage was even above that.

“The imperial realm is only the beginning.” Someone said while watching his departing figure.

Some listeners thought emperors were being humble when making this comment. However, it was indeed the truth. Many tried their whole lives and couldn’t reach this realm, becoming stuck as an ancestor or sect master. Alas, there was such a long way to go afterward.

Eventually, Li Qiye went inside and the gate closed. This marked the end of the battle.

Initially, it was a contest between Supreme Heaven and Life and Death Heaven. It escalated into a battle between immortals.

Those lucky enough to witness the battle found it to be a great honor. There couldn’t be another in the immortal world.

***

Li Qiye rested his head on a pair of jade-like legs while being fed delicacies. The beauty was none other than Bingchi Hanyu.

She was seductive to the core. Every movement was gentle and tugged at the heartstrings.

“You could become a supreme overlord.” Li Qiye said and spat out a fruit seed into her hand.

“I still fall short, Your Majesty.” She said.

“Be close to the primordial and work on your dao heart, you will break through.” Li Qiye said.

“I will not let you down.” She said softly.

“It’s a shame His Majesty can’t stay back to see your ascension.” Liu Chuqing came in.

“I can rest assured after seeing your crafted avatar.” Li Qiye said.

Bingchi Hanyu stood up and bowed at Liu Chuqing. The latter came closer into Li Qiye’s embrace.

“You are not staying long?” She asked.

He wrapped his arm around her head and gently pressed it against his chest before touching her delicate nose: “This is enough.”

She didn’t respond.

“Silly girl, you are an immortal and know that the dao is endless.” He said.

“Her Majesty wishes to accompany you.” Bingchi Hanyu smiled.

He stared straight into Liu Chuqing’s eyes and she did the same. After a long while, she hugged him and said: “Just meeting you again is enough.”

“You can still move forward.” He stroked her soft hair.

“I can’t keep up with your path and I mustn’t become a burden. Nonetheless, I will keep moving forward and won’t let down your expectations.” She said.

“I believe in you.” He smiled.

“I will cultivate in Three Immortals and protect it for you.” She said.

“I will do the same.” Bingchi Hanyu bowed.

“Very well.” Li Qiye said.

“You’ve finally returned, I suppose we shouldn’t dwell on departure already.” She winked playfully, prompting him to smile.
